question: An effect says 'All noncreature artifacts become 2/2 artifact creatures until end of turn.' Are both the type change and the power and toughness setting applied to those permanents, even though they are no longer noncreature artifacts when the second part applies?

expected.shortAnswer: Yes: both parts apply to the same permanents, chosen when the effect starts.
expected.answer: An effect that reads “All noncreature artifacts become 2/2 artifact creatures until end of turn” is both a type-changing effect and a power- and toughness-setting effect. The type-changing effect is applied to all noncreature artifacts in layer 4 and the power- and toughness-setting effect is applied to those same permanents in layer 7b, even though those permanents aren’t noncreature artifacts by then.
